synthesizedFacts.fact: Opzelura (Ruxolitinib) is the first and only JAK inhibitor cream approved for mild to moderate eczema in patients aged 2 years and older.
JAK inhibitors work by blocking the JAK signaling pathway, which reduces inflammation and alleviates symptoms of atopic dermatitis.
Common side effects of JAK inhibitors include nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, and headaches.
The FDA has issued a boxed warning for JAK inhibitors due to potential serious side effects.
